The AI-native platform uses a conversational assistant to help users discover live events more naturally.

images.alt:
thumpN Raises $3.75 Million — With Arijit Singh, Badshah and Paytm's Vijay Shekhar Sharma Betting on India's Live Entertainment Boom

Mumbai-headquartered thumpN, an AI-native discovery and ticketing platform for live entertainment, has raised over $3.75 million in a pre-seed round — and the investor list reads like a mix of Bollywood and fintech royalty: singers Arijit Singh, Sunidhi Chauhan and Badshah, alongside Paytm founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma, Paytm CFO Madhur Deora, Capitalmind co-founder Shray Chandra, and Hyperlink Brand Solutions founder VG Jairam.

The founder story adds an interesting layer here. thumpN was built by Varun Khare, the former COO of Paytm Insider — the discovery platform Zomato acquired in 2024 and folded into its District app, which is now one of thumpN's direct rivals. Co-founded with Shreyas Srinivas and Alaap Gosher in 2025, thumpN isn't just another ticket-booking app.

At the heart of the platform is Shadow, thumpN's conversational AI agent that helps fans discover live events using natural language — think asking for "a stand-up show this weekend under Rs 1,500" instead of scrolling through endless listings. The platform is backed by a network of co-curators — genre specialists, venue insiders, and city-embedded tastemakers — layered on top of the AI.

The opportunity is real: thumpN is targeting a market that hosts over 40,000 live events across 319 cities annually in India, spanning music, theatre, comedy, festivals, nightlife, sports and community-led experiences. The fresh capital will go toward scaling the AI product and expanding thumpN's curator network.

Celebrity cap tables aren't new in Indian startups, but this one signals something sharper — cultural credibility baked in from day one, in a category where trust and taste matter as much as tech.

From Bollywood stages to booking apps — India's live entertainment discovery just got its AI moment.
